questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive. You must follow the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: Which of these statements is true about work zones?

options.text: Fines for violations in work zones are the same as fines under normal traffic conditions.
You must slow down in the cone zone.
Slow down only if you see workers present.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must slow down in the cone zone.
questions.explanation: Always slow down in work zones. This keeps drivers, pedestrians, bicyclists, and road workers safe.

questions.question: You have a minor collision at an intersection with no injuries and little damage. You should:

options.text: Leave your vehicle in the traffic lane until police arrive.
Move your vehicle out of the traffic lane, if you can do so safely.
Do not move your vehicle for any reason.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle out of the traffic lane, if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: If there are no injuries or deaths and it is safe, move your vehicle out of the traffic lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The roadway ends ahead.
The road splits. You must bear right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road splits. You must bear right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: When you pull into traffic from a parked spot at the curb, you should:

options.text: Drive slower than other traffic for 200 feet.
Wait for a gap large enough to match the speed of traffic.
Wait for the first two vehicles to pass, then enter the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough to match the speed of traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging into traffic, wait for enough space to reach the same speed as the other cars around you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road widens ahead.
One lane is ending soon. Move to the left lane.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending soon. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the right lane is ending. You need to merge left.

questions.question: To drive safely on the interstate, you must:

options.text: Be able to safely drive at higher speeds.
Stay alert at all times.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: Safe interstate driving means you must stay alert and be able to drive at high speeds safely.

questions.question: "No zones" around trucks are areas where cars:

options.text: Are hidden in blind spots or are so close that the truck driver cannot stop or turn safely.
Have plenty of space behind the truck.
Are several car lengths away from the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are hidden in blind spots or are so close that the truck driver cannot stop or turn safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are blind spots around trucks and buses where cars can disappear or are too close. Being in a "no zone" greatly increases the chance of a crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or narrows ahead.
No right turn.
No passing zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is about to turn or get narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road ahead.
Do not enter.
Pedestrian crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: Which of these substances can affect your ability to drive?

options.text: Tranquilizers, marijuana, and sedatives.
Cough syrups and cold tablets with codeine or antihistamines.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Many drugs can impair your driving ability. These include tranquilizers and sedatives, over-the-counter cough syrups and cold or allergy medications that may contain alcohol, codeine, or antihistamines, and illegal drugs.

questions.question: When driving near a large commercial vehicle, you should:

options.text: Follow the large vehicle closely to reduce wind drag on your vehicle.
Avoid driving beside it for long stretches of time.
Drive on its right side when on curves and hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid driving beside it for long stretches of time.
questions.explanation: Large commercial vehicles have large blind spots on both sides. Do not drive beside them for long periods of time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No U-turn.
No turning.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: When passing parked vehicles, you should:

options.text: Be prepared for a person or vehicle to unexpectedly enter your lane.
Expect all other drivers and pedestrians to respect your right-of-way.
Drive close to the parked vehicles to allow more room for moving traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared for a person or vehicle to unexpectedly enter your lane.
questions.explanation: Keep space between your vehicle and parked vehicles. A person may step out of a parked car or between parked cars without looking. A driver may pull into traffic before seeing you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop Sign Ahead.
Side Road.
Railroad Warning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop Sign Ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: If an oncoming driver does not dim their headlights, you should:

options.text: Look toward the center of the roadway.
Look toward the right side of the road.
Look straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming driver fails to dim their headlights, look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and lets you see enough to stay on course. Do not respond by keeping your bright lights on.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road
Loose gravel
Slippery when wet

questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive with caution on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Merging traffic.
Steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to potential hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: If you are driving on a highway with a single broken white line, you:

options.text: Cannot cross the line to pass.
May cross the line to pass and change lanes.
May only cross the line to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: May cross the line to pass and change lanes.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You may cross a dashed white line to pass or change lanes if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Georgia's Implied Consent Law means:

options.text: You must sign a statement promising not to drive after having more than three drinks.
You agree to be tested for alcohol in your blood if arrested for drunk or impaired driving.
You agree to give a blood sample if an officer stops you for reckless driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: You agree to be tested for alcohol in your blood if arrested for drunk or impaired driving.
questions.explanation: Georgia's Implied Consent Law requires you to submit to chemical tests of your blood, breath, urine, or other bodily substances at a law enforcement officer's request to determine if you are under the influence of alcohol or drugs. Refusing this test will result in license suspension.

questions.question: You see pedestrians near the road. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and keep driving at the same speed.
Speed up to leave the area quickly.
Slow down and pass with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and pass with caution.
questions.explanation: When you see pedestrians near the road, slow down and be ready to stop. A pedestrian may step into your path at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Dangerous intersections ahead.
Slow-moving vehicles ahead.
Yield sign ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicles ahead.
questions.explanation: An orange reflective triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, road work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like a solid orange triangle. At night it looks like a red triangle.

questions.question: When driving at night on a dimly lit street, what should you do?

options.text: Drive slowly enough to stop within the area lit by your headlights.
Use high beam headlights to see vehicles ahead better.
Keep dashboard lights bright so other drivers can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slowly enough to stop within the area lit by your headlights.
questions.explanation: Drive slower at night than during the day because you cannot see as far ahead. Make sure you can always stop within the area your headlights illuminate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean a school zone or school crossing is ahead. When you see these signs, stay alert and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road construction ahead.
The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: A driver license is a:

options.text: Requirement.
Privilege.
Right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Privilege.
questions.explanation: Driving is a privilege, not a right. All drivers must help keep everyone safe on the road. If you misuse this privilege, it can be taken away.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down.
Stop.
Turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means "Stop." Come to a complete stop, let traffic and pedestrians pass, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an upcoming corner. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: Oncoming vehicles also turning left.
All approaching vehicles.
Pedestrians on the sidewalk waiting for a "Walk" signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: All approaching vehicles.
questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and other vehicles coming toward you on a green light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a railroad crossing. Prepare to stop.
You must always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching a railroad crossing. Prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you cross the tracks.

questions.question: In a car on a highway, is it legal to have open alcohol?

options.text: No. Drinking or having open alcohol containers is illegal.
Yes, if you are not the driver.
Yes, if the driver is not drunk.

questions.correctAnswerText: No. Drinking or having open alcohol containers is illegal.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive while under the influence of alcohol. Drivers and passengers cannot drink from or keep open alcohol containers in a car that is moving.
